findings.title: Mutex contention hotspot at 0x00000011ebf51140
findings.summary: 8 threads waited 61 times (7/s) for mutex 0x00000011ebf51140; someone was waiting 0% of the time; p99 wait 1.05 ms.
findings.qnx_note: Every MUTEX-state interval is real contention: uncontended QNX mutexes never enter the kernel. Shrink the critical section (copy outside the lock), split the lock per resource, or hand buffers between threads with message passing.

findings.title: Unusual behaviour in nng_repro_fixed[16]
findings.summary: nng_repro_fixed[16] (prio 10) behaved unlike healthy QNX programs in 45 of its 45 time windows; the most unusual stretch lasted 900 ms. It stands out in: time waiting on a condition variable (higher than healthy), longest single block (higher than healthy), CPU migrations (higher than healthy). The closest pattern TraceLens has seen is priority inversion while waiting on a condition variable, but only loosely (distance 9.96 against 0.847 typical for it): treat this as behaviour of its own.
findings.qnx_note: Learned from healthy QNX 8.0 traces: this thread behaved unlike any healthy run in the features listed. It is not a proven bug and gets no automatic fix: look at the timeline around it. Any resemblance to a known pattern is measured against labelled example windows, never a rule that fired.
